key_insight: TOF3D enables large-scale 3D topology optimization on a consumer GPU using single precision while suppressing numerical errors through displacement-difference element products.
engineering_relevance: The open-source Python code makes stress-constrained, manufacturing-robust, compliant-mechanism and bone-like porous-infill optimization accessible on a single 12 GB GPU.
method: Density-based topology optimization with a matrix-free stiffness operator.
Conjugate gradient solver preconditioned by geometric multigrid.
Displacement-difference element products preserve rigid-body behavior in single precision.
evidence_signal: On an RTX 3060, cantilever iterations took 0.46 s for 0.5 million elements and 15 s for 33.5 million; the numerical reformulation reduced compliance error from up to 5.4% to 1.3×10⁻⁵.
watch_item: Naively rounding element matrices to single precision introduces spurious rigid-body energy, so the displacement-difference formulation is essential to the reported accuracy.
paper_title: An open source Python code for three-dimensional topology optimization in single precision on a consumer GPU
